run_actor_loop: run the actor loop that creates an Atari environment and runs RL episodes via TorchBeast
run_main_entry: run the main entry point that sets up logging and starts the actor loop
create_atari_environment: create an Atari environment using the environment module for reinforcement learning
connect_torchbeast_client: connect a TorchBeast client to the server for inference during RL episodes
request_inference_action: request an inference action from the TorchBeast server given observation reward and done
